author: CC
prose:
Group H per-proof cause list, measured on Windows (akiendell) 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13, handed over as ONE file at the orchestrator's request. Each cause is cast as its own ticket when a fix for it is measured; nothing here is cast as a group.

1. CRLF fixtures (H1, 3d796b46f449): 4 proofs. Held by Q#90; red-first proof on origin branch h1-red-first-3d796b46f449.

2. The scratch line 'scratch: could not sweep ...ws-shim-pulse-scratch...web_server.log WinError 32' is stderr noise, not a failure: one leftover directory held by a live process. The census 'first' field in rr_h misleads because it recorded that line first for 17 proofs.

3. Hollow family. Not one cause.
 a) test_hollow_anchors_before_the_build_that_stands, test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits and test_hollow's live-anchor tooth read live berths and commits for tickets 68f5 and c691 that exist only on the Linux box. Re-checked 2026-11-13 after akienasus's c8e421aac06e and 18cd321cd045: one tooth was still red, test_an_anchor_holding_every_file_raises_naming_the_anchor, caused by the fixture repo carrying no core.autocrlf pin (CRLF worktree bytes against an LF blob read as 'reverted'). Cast as 2c3ea22bc266, held by Q#90 (tester section 9.4.2.3.3); red-first proof on origin branch 3a-red-first-2c3ea22bc266. test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits is red only because it re-runs test_hollow.py.
 b) test_hollow imported scratch.py from C:\automation\local\cairn from outside its worktree: the closure runner's sys.path[0] is the caller's cwd. Cast as cfb4cb45d85c, held by Q#90; proof on origin branch 3b-red-first-cfb4cb45d85c.
 c) killed_reseal compares 'widget\\proofs\\test_a.py' to 'widget/proofs/test_a.py': a code-side os.sep path emitted by the tester (3c). Parked under Q#90.
 d) hollow.py:651 and reseal.py:133 emit str(relative_to) with backslashes. as_posix at both sites changed three proofs from one failure to another and none went green; reverted. A partial cause entangled with (a) and (b) (3d). Parked under Q#90.
 e) The three the_migration_* teeth of test_hollow are red on Windows only (Linux reads 29/29 green). Measured on Windows only, root cause not investigated, unclassified.

4. fixture_instance_address: 'verb resolved C:\\...' in 3 proofs (cairn_instance_address, launcher_reads_bin, instance_address) comparing a resolved Windows path to a posix literal. H3, cast and pushed.

5. Single-cause one-offs: the_ticket_is_three_files passes a Windows path through /bin/bash (H2, 349584bb8f69, held by Q#90; proof on origin branch h2-red-first-349584bb8f69). test_cast_ticket compares a backslash frame to posix. question_links says 'cairn question: answer refused'. librarian_library: 'shelve must refuse ShelfRefused, it did not'. venv_imports hits StopIteration. unhandled_mail and idle_trigger fail on a Windows path or a missing file. deposit_survives_a_move is dropped: fixed by akienasus (f153192145dd, fae683381).

6. test_scratch.py: two Windows-only teeth, the reach tooth (backslash path) and the stuck-sweep tooth (chmod locks nothing on NTFS). Cast as 852b6b5fa4bd, built, at PROVEME with seal open on Windows.
